| 🌱 **q-0026.0007** · What does the harness need while its own rules are amended many times a day, under sessions still running? |
|---|
| **q-0026.0007.0001** · How does a running session learn that the entry file moved under it? (moved here from q-0025.0006) |

## I see what you mean, and I've filed it that way

You're right. The need comes from this tree's own pace: 24 changes to the entry file in two and a half days, with several sessions running under them. In a normal project the rules file seldom changes in the middle of a session. So "a running session learns the rules moved" is not something every project with the harness needs. It belongs to the mode where the harness is being amended many times a day, which is mostly this repository.

**What I changed, committed and pushed:**
- **A new question for that mode, q-0026.0007,** under q-0026 (how the harness amends its own rules), since high-frequency amendment is one way of amending. Its body records your framing and the evidence: the 24 changes, and failure 34.
- **The entry-file question moved under it,** from q-0025.0006 to q-0026.0007.0001. The ticket's link and a session record's citation were repaired along with the move.

**What I left where it was.** Two other questions exist mostly because the rules move fast, but I'm not sure they belong only to this mode:
- **q-0025.0003**, whether a session still needs to announce the entry contract version. You've called that announce line a debugging line.
- **q-0026.0003**, what an entry-contract version covers. Versions also matter to other projects that take harness releases, so this one may be a general need.

| ⚖️ Decisions |
|---|
| Whether 01-0018.0010 leaves the regular queue and waits with q-0026.0007 until you take up that mode as a whole |
| Whether q-0025.0003 (the announce line) moves under q-0026.0007 too |
| What this session picks up next: the environment align on q-0018.0022, or the align on q-0026.0003 |
